_about: The bandage buff (the owner, 2026-10-24: legs and hands full, pain, body and head 35 %; srp-026g/docs/notes/bandages.md). Pack of bandages (bandages, dict id 66, the only bandage of 0.26g's dictionary): an influence is the pool's health added per second while the drug is active (medkit::tick 0x33D790: amount x the elapsed seconds x drug_amount (57), increase_health 0x32A420, clamped to the pool's max), for data/activity_time_sec 1 s after activation_delay_sec 1 s. Hands and legs (max 0.5) 0.3/s -> 1/s, full as the medkit's 1/s; three new influences after right_leg, made like it: body (max 1.0) 0.35/s, head (max 0.4) 0.14/s, pain (max 1.0) 0.35/s, 35 % of each pool in the 1 s. The lobby (the owner, 2026-10-25): st_base_bandages_description says what it heals, in the six localization tables (UTF-8, as they keep their texts; every character already used in its table, '%' unspaced as theirs); the card's Heal amount line (props_list prop_id 12, "30") is taken out, so it no longer contradicts the text. The injury removal, times and weight unchanged.

edit_text.from: A standard set of bandages. Serves well as a first-aid tool in the battlefield. Use it to neutralize the critical effect of arms and legs wounds.
edit_text.to: Fully heals arms and legs. Restores 35% of body, head and pain.

edit_text.from: Das standardmäßige  Erste-Hilfe Paket. Kommt ausgezeichnet für die Erweisung der Erstversorgung unter den Bedingungen des Kampfs heran. Bei der Nutzung neutralisiert den Effekt der kritischen Verwundung der Hände und der Beine.
edit_text.to: Heilt Arme und Beine vollständig. Stellt 35% von Körper, Kopf und Schmerz wieder her.

edit_text.from: Standardowy zestaw bandaży Wykorzystywane są do udzielania pierwszej pomocy na polu bitwy. Opatruj nimi krytyczne rany rąk i nóg.
edit_text.to: W pełni leczy ręce i nogi. Przywraca 35% zdrowia tułowia, głowy i bólu.

edit_text.from: Стандартный перевязочный пакет. Отлично подходит для оказания первой помощи в условиях боя. При использовании нейтрализует эффект критического ранения рук и ног.
edit_text.to: Полностью лечит руки и ноги. Восстанавливает 35% здоровья тела, головы и боли.

edit_text.to: Повністю лікує руки і ноги. Відновлює 35% здоров'я тіла, голови та болю.
